label: D/E/C (skeptic)
note:
Smaller checks of mf_hybrid [D/E/C]: gravitational X production, wall timescales, neutrino-mass sum of the seesaw
singlets, spectator isocurvature with mf_ideal's p, the spectator's one-loop mass from N_s, the induced holder portal
leak, the light-neutrino-mass sensitivity of the Pauli-blocked history.
Usage: python3 -B sk_misc.py -> ../results/sk_misc.json

grav_X.note: D: Gamma(phi->xx) = sigma^2/(32 pi m) for -sigma phi x^2/2 gives dE/dt = A^2 w/(64 pi) per real dof; the track used w = m_chi (x2 low). Still ~1e-3 of E_X

walls_if_formed.note: E: scaling-network estimates; if the Pauli-limited waterfall fragments and walls percolate, they dominate at t ~ 1/(2 H_dom) before the bias removes them

neutrino_mass_sum.note: D: with real R the light masses sum to sum_j mtilde_j = 0.20 eV (0.25 eV with a fifth, seesaw-coupled N_s). Planck 2018+BAO (1807.06209) < 0.12 eV, DESI DR2+CMB (2503.14744) < 0.064 eV (retrospective). Either a complex R with sum_j |R_ji|^2 ~ 3 (cancellations in m_nu, large CP phases) or smaller mtilde (slower N decays) is needed

isocurvature.note: C/Q: Planck 2018 X (1807.06211) beta_iso < 0.038; with mf_ideal p = 4.4-5.1 the bench s_* = 3e-3 M_P gives beta = 0.075-0.098 (retrospective conflict); p must come from mf_chain

spectator_Ns_loop.note: D: the N_s loop gives |m_s^2| = 0.004 (12L - 4) H^2 at s_*, L = ln(y^2 s^2/mu^2); <= 0.01 H^2 only for |L - 1/3| <~ 0.2 (a renormalisation choice). N_s needs a soft Majorana mass (< 1.5 H_i) and a seesaw Yukawa to reach the SM; otherwise it is dark radiation (Delta N_eff ~ 0.04 at f_s = 1.3%)

induced_holder_portal.note: E: zero only if the induced portal vanishes at the stated scale (M_Y benchmark); the track says "no hidden heat" without this channel
